name: Utsuro Nikki
source:
Main character 「Hataro」has a girlfriend and is a socialable regular high school student
It’s a diary exchange. It’s popular these days Hataro-kun. Don’t you know? Everyone’s doing it.
The girlfriend 「Utsuro」’s idea to start the popular diary exchange.
The slightest trigger was the beginning of a nightmare...

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Uturo&hl=en_US&gl=US&referrer=utm_source%3Dgoogle%26utm_medium%3Dorganic%26utm_term%3Dutsuro+diary&pcampaignid=APPU_1_uMB5YO6GDZS7wAP754qIDQ]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
主角叶太郎是一名平凡的高中生，性格合群，也有女朋友。
“是交换日记啦，叶太郎！最近不是很流行吗？你不知道？大家都在写哦。”
在女友虚的提议下，两人开始写起时下流行的交换日记。
这个微不足道的契机，却成了噩梦的开端……
